+"""Read-only RPF3 reader for Midnight Club: Los Angeles (Xbox 360).
+
+Format readings (independently written; CodeX.Games.MCLA `RPF3/Rpf3File.cs` at
+dedc3156 was the format reference, no code copied), each checked by the reader:
+
+- Header, little-endian: `RPF3`, table size, entry count, unknown, encryption flag.
+  The table starts at 0x800. A nonzero flag means the table is AES-256-ECB
+  encrypted sixteen times over its 16-byte-aligned prefix.
+- 16-byte entries. A negative third word marks a directory: name hash, flags,
+  first child index | 0x80000000, child count. Otherwise a file: name hash,
+  size, offset, flag word. Flag bits 0xC0000000 both set mark an RSC resource
+  whose offset carries the resource type in its low byte; otherwise bit
+  0x40000000 marks raw-DEFLATE compression and the rest is the stored size.
+- Names are 32-bit Jenkins one-at-a-time hashes; no names are stored.
+"""
+import struct
+import zlib
+
+from aes_decrypt import AesDecryptor
+
+MAGIC = b'RPF3'
+TOC_OFFSET = 0x800
+ENTRY = 16
+MAX_ENTRIES = 1_000_000
+RESOURCE = 0xC0000000
+COMPRESSED = 0x40000000
+RSC5 = b'\x05CSR'  # reading of the resource magic as stored big-endian on this disc
+
+
+def jenkins_partial(text, h=0):
+    """Jenkins one-at-a-time mixing over lower-cased ASCII, resumable from a prefix state."""
+    for byte in text.lower().encode('ascii'):
+        h = (h + byte) & 0xFFFFFFFF
+        h = (h + (h << 10)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
+        h ^= h >> 6
+    return h
+
+
+def jenkins_final(h):
+    h = (h + (h << 3)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
+    h ^= h >> 11
+    return (h + (h << 15)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
+
+
+def jenkins(text):
+    """The RAGE name hash: Jenkins one-at-a-time over lower-cased ASCII."""
+    return jenkins_final(jenkins_partial(text))
+
+
+def aes_ecb_decrypt16(data, key):
+    """Sixteen AES-256-ECB decryption passes over the 16-byte-aligned prefix."""
+    aligned = len(data) & ~15
+    aes, body = AesDecryptor(key), data[:aligned]
+    for _ in range(16):
+        body = aes.ecb(body)
+    return body + data[aligned:]
+
+
+def virtual_size(flag):
+    return (flag & 0x7FF) << (((flag >> 11) & 15) + 8)
+
+
+def physical_size(flag):
+    return ((flag >> 15) & 0x7FF) << (((flag >> 26) & 15) + 8)
+
+
+class Rpf3Archive:
+    """Lists entries of one RPF3 image held behind `read(offset, size)`."""
+
+    def __init__(self, read, size, key=None):
+        self.read, self.size = read, size
+        if size < TOC_OFFSET:
+            raise ValueError('RPF3 smaller than its header page')
+        magic, toc_size, count, self.unknown, encrypted = struct.unpack('<4sIIIi', read(0, 20))
+        if magic != MAGIC:
+            raise ValueError('not an RPF3 archive')
+        if not 0 < count <= MAX_ENTRIES or count * ENTRY > toc_size or TOC_OFFSET + toc_size > size:
+            raise ValueError('RPF3 table outside archive')
+        self.encrypted = encrypted != 0
+        table = read(TOC_OFFSET, toc_size)
+        if self.encrypted:
+            if key is None:
+                raise ValueError('encrypted RPF3 table needs the AES key')
+            table = aes_ecb_decrypt16(table, key)
+        self.toc_size, self.count = toc_size, count
+        self.entries = [self._entry(index, table[index * ENTRY:(index + 1) * ENTRY]) for index in range(count)]
+        root = self.entries[0]
+        if root['kind'] != 'directory':
+            raise ValueError('RPF3 root is not a directory')
+        self._link()
+
+    def _entry(self, index, raw):
+        name, a, b, c = struct.unpack('<IIII', raw)
+        if b & 0x80000000:
+            return {'index': index, 'kind': 'directory', 'hash': name, 'flags': a,
+                    'first': b & 0x7FFFFFFF, 'children': c & 0x0FFFFFFF}
+        entry = {'index': index, 'kind': 'file', 'hash': name, 'size': a, 'flag': c}
+        if c & RESOURCE == RESOURCE:
+            entry.update(resource=True, resource_type=b & 0xFF, offset=b & 0x7FFFFF00,
+                         stored=a, virtual=virtual_size(c), physical=physical_size(c))
+        else:
+            entry.update(resource=False, offset=b, compressed=bool(c & COMPRESSED), stored=c & 0x3FFFFFFF)
+        if entry['offset'] + entry['stored'] > self.size:
+            raise ValueError('RPF3 file outside archive')
+        return entry
+
+    def _link(self):
+        parents = {0: None}
+        stack = [0]
+        while stack:
+            directory = self.entries[stack.pop()]
+            first, count = directory['first'], directory['children']
+            if first + count > self.count or (count and first <= directory['index']):
+                raise ValueError('RPF3 directory children outside table')
+            for child in range(first, first + count):
+                if child in parents:
+                    raise ValueError('RPF3 entry has two parents')
+                parents[child] = directory['index']
+                if self.entries[child]['kind'] == 'directory':
+                    stack.append(child)
+        if len(parents) != self.count:
+            raise ValueError('RPF3 entries unreachable from root')
+        for entry in self.entries:
+            entry['parent'] = parents[entry['index']]
+
+    def stored(self, entry):
+        return self.read(entry['offset'], entry['stored'])
+
+    def payload(self, entry):
+        """Archive-level decoding only: raw DEFLATE is inflated; RSC resources stay as stored."""
+        data = self.stored(entry)
+        if entry['resource']:
+            if data[:4] != RSC5:
+                raise ValueError('RPF3 resource without RSC5 header')
+            return data
+        if not entry['compressed']:
+            return data
+        inflater = zlib.decompressobj(-15)
+        out = inflater.decompress(data, entry['size'] + 1)
+        if len(out) != entry['size'] or inflater.unconsumed_tail or not inflater.eof:
+            raise ValueError('RPF3 deflate size mismatch')
+        return out

+"""FIPS-197 appendix C known-answer vectors, CBC chaining and malformed-input controls.
+
+`AesEncryptor` is a deliberately plain, test-only forward cipher used to build encrypted
+fixtures for the MCLA disc tests; it is checked against the same vectors.
+"""
+import unittest
+
+from aes_decrypt import SBOX, AesDecryptor
+
+
+def _xtime(a):
+    return ((a << 1) ^ (0x1B if a & 0x80 else 0)) & 0xFF
+
+
+class AesEncryptor:
+    def __init__(self, key):
+        nk = len(key) // 4
+        self.rounds = nk + 6
+        words = [list(key[4 * i:4 * i + 4]) for i in range(nk)]
+        rcon = 1
+        for i in range(nk, 4 * (self.rounds + 1)):
+            t = list(words[i - 1])
+            if i % nk == 0:
+                t = [SBOX[b] for b in t[1:] + t[:1]]
+                t[0] ^= rcon
+                rcon = _xtime(rcon)
+            elif nk > 6 and i % nk == 4:
+                t = [SBOX[b] for b in t]
+            words.append([a ^ b for a, b in zip(words[i - nk], t)])
+        self.keys = [sum(words[4 * r:4 * r + 4], []) for r in range(self.rounds + 1)]
+
+    def block(self, data):
+        s = [a ^ b for a, b in zip(data, self.keys[0])]
+        for r in range(1, self.rounds + 1):
+            s = [SBOX[b] for b in s]
+            s = [s[(i + 4 * (i % 4)) % 16] for i in range(16)]  # ShiftRows on column-major state
+            if r < self.rounds:
+                mixed = []
+                for c in range(4):
+                    a = s[4 * c:4 * c + 4]
+                    total = a[0] ^ a[1] ^ a[2] ^ a[3]
+                    mixed += [a[i] ^ total ^ _xtime(a[i] ^ a[(i + 1) % 4]) for i in range(4)]
+                s = mixed
+            s = [a ^ b for a, b in zip(s, self.keys[r])]
+        return bytes(s)
+
+    def ecb(self, data):
+        return b''.join(self.block(data[i:i + 16]) for i in range(0, len(data), 16))
+
+    def cbc(self, data, iv=bytes(16)):
+        out, previous = bytearray(), iv
+        for i in range(0, len(data), 16):
+            previous = self.block(bytes(a ^ b for a, b in zip(data[i:i + 16], previous)))
+            out += previous
+        return bytes(out)
+
+
+PLAIN = bytes.fromhex('00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff')
+VECTORS = [
+    ('000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f', '69c4e0d86a7b0430d8cdb78070b4c55a'),
+    ('000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f1011121314151617', 'dda97ca4864cdfe06eaf70a0ec0d7191'),
+    ('000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f', '8ea2b7ca516745bfeafc49904b496089'),
+]
+
+
+class AesTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_fips197_vectors(self):
+        for key, cipher in VECTORS:
+            self.assertEqual(AesDecryptor(bytes.fromhex(key)).block(bytes.fromhex(cipher)), PLAIN)
+
+    def test_fixture_encryptor_round_trips(self):
+        for key, cipher in VECTORS:
+            self.assertEqual(AesEncryptor(bytes.fromhex(key)).block(PLAIN).hex(), cipher)
+        key = bytes(range(32))
+        data = bytes(range(256)) * 2
+        self.assertEqual(AesDecryptor(key).cbc(AesEncryptor(key).cbc(data, b'v' * 16), b'v' * 16), data)
+
+    def test_wrong_key_does_not_decrypt(self):
+        key, cipher = VECTORS[2]
+        wrong = bytearray.fromhex(key)
+        wrong[0] ^= 1
+        self.assertNotEqual(AesDecryptor(bytes(wrong)).block(bytes.fromhex(cipher)), PLAIN)
+
+    def test_cbc_chains_previous_ciphertext(self):
+        # NIST SP 800-38A F.2.2 (CBC-AES128.Decrypt), first two blocks.
+        aes = AesDecryptor(bytes.fromhex('2b7e151628aed2a6abf7158809cf4f3c'))
+        iv = bytes.fromhex('000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f')
+        cipher = bytes.fromhex('7649abac8119b246cee98e9b12e9197d5086cb9b507219ee95db113a917678b2')
+        self.assertEqual(aes.cbc(cipher, iv).hex(),
+                         '6bc1bee22e409f96e93d7e117393172aae2d8a571e03ac9c9eb76fac45af8e51')
+        self.assertEqual(aes.ecb(cipher[:16]), aes.cbc(cipher[:16], bytes(16)))
+
+    def test_rejects_partial_blocks_and_bad_keys(self):
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'key must be'):
+            AesDecryptor(b'short')
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'whole blocks'):
+            AesDecryptor(bytes(16)).ecb(b'x' * 17)
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'whole blocks'):
+            AesDecryptor(bytes(16)).cbc(b'x' * 16, b'iv')
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()

+"""Extraction controls derive expectations from a synthetic disc, never from its index."""
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import extract_mcla_cars
+from extract_mcla_cars import Named, check_extraction, dictionary, owner, write_extraction
+from mcla_rpf import RSC5, Rpf3Archive, jenkins
+from test_mcla_rpf import rpf_fixture
+from test_xdvdfs import disc_fixture
+from test_xex2 import pe_image, xex_fixture
+
+KEY = bytes(range(100, 132))
+PIN = hashlib.sha256(KEY).hexdigest()
+NAMES = (b'resources vehicle vp_test_car_01 vp_test_car_01_dub body_lod_0 configs ambients resources/ui/textures/garage '
+         b'sh_vp_test_car_01_dub other rims whl_stk_x city tune handling.xml names.xml common.xcc '
+         b'gh_01_vp_test_car_01_dub mr_vp_hidden_02 ped_fa_001_set amb')
+
+
+def resource(kind, label):
+    return ('resource', kind, RSC5 + b'\0\0\0' + bytes([kind]) + label)
+
+
+def tree(extra_vehicle=None):
+    vehicles = {
+        'vp_test_car_01': {'body_lod_0.xrsc': resource(63, b'car body'), 'vp_test_car_01.xct': resource(50, b'tune'),
+                           'unnamedpart.xrsc': resource(63, b'hidden part')},
+        'vp_test_car_01_dub': {'body_lod_0.xrsc': resource(63, b'dub body')},
+        'vp_hidden_02': {'body_lod_0.xrsc': resource(63, b'hidden car')},
+        'secretdir': {'body_lod_0.xrsc': resource(63, b'unknown car')},
+        'configs': {'vp_test_car_01.xcc': ('deflate', b'config one' * 30),
+                    'gh_01_vp_test_car_01_dub.xcc': ('deflate', b'config dub' * 30),
+                    'common.xcc': ('loose', b'shared config')}}
+    vehicles.update(extra_vehicle or {})
+    return {'resources': {
+        'vehicle': vehicles,
+        'ambients': {'vp_test_car_01': {'amb.xaph': resource(51, b'ambient')},
+                     'ped_fa_001_set': {'amb.xaph': resource(51, b'pedestrian')}},
+        'ui': {'textures': {'garage': {'sh_vp_test_car_01_dub.xtd': resource(9, b'showroom'),
+                                       'other.xtd': resource(9, b'not a car')}}},
+        'rims': {'whl_stk_x': {'whl_stk_x.xtp': resource(83, b'rim')}},
+        'city': {'sc.xct': resource(50, b'city')}},
+        'tune': {'vehicle': {'handling.xml': ('loose', b'<handling/>')}, 'names.xml': ('deflate', NAMES)}}
+
+
+def fixture(path, extra_vehicle=None):
+    image = pe_image(KEY)
+    path.write_bytes(disc_fixture([('default.xex', xex_fixture(image)),
+                                   ('xarchive_cache.rpf', rpf_fixture(tree(extra_vehicle), KEY))]))
+    return path
+
+
+class NameTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_plausibility_ambiguity_and_borrowed_extensions(self):
+        image = rpf_fixture({'vehicle': {'part.xrsc': resource(63, b'a'), 'other.xrsc': resource(63, b'b'),
+                                         'notes.xml': ('loose', b'n'), 'twin.xrsc': resource(63, b'c')}})
+        archive = Rpf3Archive(lambda o, s: image[o:o + s], len(image))
+        names = dictionary({'vehicle', 'part', 'notes.xml'}, {e['hash'] for e in archive.entries})
+        by_hash = {e['hash']: e for e in archive.entries}
+        names[jenkins('vehicle')].append('noise.xtd')        # a dotted collision for a directory
+        names[jenkins('notes.xml')].append('noise.xrsc')     # a resource extension for a loose file
+        names[jenkins('twin.xrsc')] = ['twin.xrsc', 'twin_b.xrsc']  # two plausible candidates
+        named = Named(archive, names)
+        self.assertEqual(named.name(by_hash[jenkins('vehicle')]), ('vehicle', 'resolved'))
+        self.assertEqual(named.name(by_hash[jenkins('notes.xml')]), ('notes.xml', 'resolved'))
+        self.assertEqual(named.name(by_hash[jenkins('part.xrsc')]), ('part.xrsc', 'resolved'))
+        self.assertEqual(named.name(by_hash[jenkins('twin.xrsc')]), ('0x%08x.xrsc' % jenkins('twin.xrsc'), 'unresolved'))
+        self.assertEqual(named.name(by_hash[jenkins('other.xrsc')])[1], 'unresolved')
+        rows = {row['path']: row for row in named.inventory()}
+        self.assertEqual(rows['vehicle/']['rejected_candidates'], ['noise.xtd'])
+        self.assertEqual(rows['vehicle/0x%08x.xrsc' % jenkins('twin.xrsc')]['name_candidates'], ['twin.xrsc', 'twin_b.xrsc'])
+
+    def test_embedded_codes_and_longest_owner(self):
+        names = dictionary({'mr_vp_nsn_gtr_08'}, {jenkins('vp_nsn_gtr_08'), jenkins('vp_nsn_gtr_08.xct')})
+        self.assertEqual(names, {jenkins('vp_nsn_gtr_08'): ['vp_nsn_gtr_08'],
+                                 jenkins('vp_nsn_gtr_08.xct'): ['vp_nsn_gtr_08.xct']})
+        codes = ['vp_lam_murcielago_06', 'vp_lam_murcielago_06_dub']
+        self.assertEqual(owner('ui/sh_vp_lam_murcielago_06_dub.xtd', codes), 'vp_lam_murcielago_06_dub')
+        self.assertEqual(owner('ui/sh_vp_lam_murcielago_06.xtd', codes), 'vp_lam_murcielago_06')
+        self.assertIsNone(owner('ui/gh_vp_lam_murcielago_06a.xcc', codes))
+
+
+class ExtractionTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):

+
+    def test_per_car_shared_and_provenance_layout(self):

+        original = iso.read_bytes()
+        index, files = write_extraction(iso, self.root / 'cars')

+        self.assertEqual([v['id'] for v in index['vehicles']],
+                         sorted([hidden, 'vp_hidden_02', 'vp_test_car_01', 'vp_test_car_01_dub']))
+        names = {row['file'] for row in files}
+        car = 'vp_test_car_01/resources/'
+        unresolved = '0x%08x.xrsc' % jenkins('unnamedpart.xrsc')
+        self.assertTrue({car + 'vehicle/vp_test_car_01/body_lod_0.xrsc', car + 'vehicle/vp_test_car_01/vp_test_car_01.xct',
+                         car + 'vehicle/vp_test_car_01/' + unresolved, car + 'vehicle/configs/vp_test_car_01.xcc',
+                         car + 'ambients/vp_test_car_01/amb.xaph',
+                         'vp_test_car_01_dub/resources/vehicle/configs/gh_01_vp_test_car_01_dub.xcc',
+                         'vp_test_car_01_dub/resources/ui/textures/garage/sh_vp_test_car_01_dub.xtd',
+                         'vp_hidden_02/resources/vehicle/vp_hidden_02/body_lod_0.xrsc',
+                         hidden + '/resources/vehicle/0x%08x/body_lod_0.xrsc' % jenkins('secretdir'),
+                         'shared/resources/vehicle/configs/common.xcc', 'shared/resources/rims/whl_stk_x/whl_stk_x.xtp',
+                         'shared/tune/vehicle/handling.xml', 'provenance/disc.inventory.json',
+                         'provenance/xarchive_cache.rpf.inventory.json', 'provenance/archive-key.json',
+                         'index.json'} <= names)
+        self.assertFalse(any(n.endswith(('other.xtd', 'sc.xct', 'names.xml')) or 'ped_fa' in n for n in names))
+        self.assertEqual((self.root / 'cars' / car / 'vehicle/configs/vp_test_car_01.xcc').read_bytes(), b'config one' * 30)
+        manifest = json.loads((self.root / 'cars/vp_test_car_01/manifest.json').read_text())
+        sources = {row['source']['archive_path']: row['source'] for row in manifest['files']}
+        self.assertEqual(sources['resources/vehicle/vp_test_car_01/' + unresolved]['name_source'], 'unresolved')
+        self.assertTrue(sources['resources/vehicle/configs/vp_test_car_01.xcc']['compressed'])
+        self.assertEqual(sources['resources/vehicle/vp_test_car_01/body_lod_0.xrsc']['resource_type'], 63)
+        key_record = json.loads((self.root / 'cars/provenance/archive-key.json').read_text())
+        self.assertEqual(key_record['key_sha256'], PIN)
+        self.assertNotIn(KEY.hex(), (self.root / 'cars/provenance/archive-key.json').read_text())
+        self.assertEqual(index['source']['sha1'], hashlib.sha1(original).hexdigest())
+        repeated, checked = check_extraction(iso, self.root / 'cars')
+        self.assertEqual(index, repeated)
+        self.assertEqual(files, checked)
+        self.assertEqual(iso.read_bytes(), original)
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'absent or empty'):
+            write_extraction(iso, self.root / 'cars')
+
+    def test_rewritten_index_cannot_mask_payload_tampering(self):
+        iso = fixture(self.root / 'source.iso')
